title: Waiver of Premium Rider Rate by Issue Age — Term Life Insurance Converted Quarterly Installment
content:
**Rider rate table — Term Life Insurance.** For the converted quarterly installment (set when a policy is converted to quarterly direct billing after its monthly bank-draft privilege ends), the waiver rate applied to the waiver charge base of a policy carrying the waiver of premium rider is set by the insured's issue age — the whole years from the insured's date of birth to the issue date on record.

| Insured's issue age | Waiver rate |
|---|---|
| 45 or more | 0.14 |
| 35 through 44 | 0.11 |
| below 35 | 0.09 |

**Input - judgement - output.**

- Date of birth 20 June 1980, issue date 19 June 2015: 34 whole years (the 35th birthday falls a day later) — below 35 — 0.09.
- Date of birth 20 June 1980, issue date 20 June 2015: 35 whole years — 35 through 44 — 0.11.
- Date of birth 2 March 1970, issue date 2 March 2015: 45 whole years — 45 or more — 0.14.

The issue age is measured from the dates on record; it is not the insured's age today.
